950 ((((uint32_t)(major) & 0x3FFU) << 22U) | \
951 (((uint32_t)(minor) & 0x3FFU) << 12U) | ((uint32_t)(patch) & 0xFFFU))

958#define QDMI_VERSION_PATCH(version) ((uint32_t)(version) & 0xFFFU)

1035typedef struct QDMI_PROGRAM_FORMAT_T {
1036 uint32_t version;
1037 uint32_t encoding;
1038 char id[QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE];
1039 char profile[QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE];
1040} QDMI_Program_Format;
1041
1042#ifdef __cplusplus
1043static_assert(sizeof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 136U);
1044static_assert(alignof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 4U);
1045static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, version) == 0U);
1046static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, encoding) == 4U);
1047static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, id) == 8U);
1048static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, profile) == 72U);
1049#else
1050_Static_assert(sizeof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 136U,
1051 "QDMI_Program_Format must be 136 bytes");
1052_Static_assert(_Alignof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 4U,
1053 "QDMI_Program_Format must have four-byte alignment");
1054_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, version) == 0U,
1055 "QDMI_Program_Format.version must start at byte 0");
1056_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, encoding) == 4U,
1057 "QDMI_Program_Format.encoding must start at byte 4");
1058_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, id) == 8U,
1059 "QDMI_Program_Format.id must start at byte 8");
1060_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, profile) == 72U,
1061 "QDMI_Program_Format.profile must start at byte 72");
1062#endif
1063
1070static inline int
1071QDMI_program_format_equal(const QDMI_Program_Format *const lhs,
1072 const QDMI_Program_Format *const rhs) {
1073 if (lhs == NULL || rhs == NULL || lhs->version != rhs->version ||
1074 lhs->encoding != rhs->encoding) {
1075 return 0;
1076 }
1077 for (size_t index = 0U; index < QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE; ++index) {
1078 if (lhs->id[index] != rhs->id[index] ||
1079 lhs->profile[index] != rhs->profile[index]) {
1080 return 0;
1081 }
1082 }
1083 return 1;
1084}
